models.name: todoapp_guest
models.description:
Stores unconfirmed user registrations for new members. Contains temporary account details before email verification.

This table serves the purpose of holding pending user accounts prior to email verification. The guest table includes all necessary information to initiate the registration process but is only transient until verified. Once confirmation is complete, the associated data is moved to the Member table and removed from Guest.

Fields include an email address for contact, a hashed password for security, and a confirmation token for verification. The created_at timestamp records the initial registration time, and updated_at tracks modifications to the record.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email for registration; must be unique across all guest accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: bcrypt hash of the password; stored securely to prevent exposure of plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: confirmation_token
plainFields.description: Temporary token for email verification; expires 24 hours after creating the account.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the guest account was created; used for tracking registration dates.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modified time for this guest record; updates when token is refreshed or data changed.

models.name: todoapp_member
models.description:
Stores verified user accounts that can manage tasks. This is the primary user entity for task ownership.

This table represents the active users of the Todo List application who have completed email verification. The Member table contains all necessary data to manage personal tasks securely. It does not support guest functionality but is the main user entity that owns all tasks.

Each member's account includes their email, password hash, and timestamps for when the account was created and confirmed. The confirmed_at field clearly marks when the user became a verified member.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Verified user email address; must be unique among all members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: bcrypt hash of the password; securely stored to authenticate user login without exposing plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the member account was created; helps track account age.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last time the member record was modified; useful for passive ID tracking.

plainFields.name: confirmed_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the email confirmation was completed; marks the transition from guest to member status.

models.name: todoapp_tasks
models.description:
Core task entity for the Todo application containing user tasks.

Stores individual to-do items with management capabilities like creation, completion, and deletion.
Each task is associated with a specific member and has a unique title within that member's scope.

Primary purpose is to store task data in a simple, performant structure with proper historical tracking via soft deletion.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who owns this task. {@link todoapp_member.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title content (max 255 characters). Strictly validates input size and doesn't allow empty values.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Binary flag indicating whether task is completed (true) or pending (false). Defaults to false on creation.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when task was marked as completed. Set to NULL when task is uncompleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the task was created. Automatically assigned by database on creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the task. Updated automatically on any change to task data.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when task was soft-deleted. Remains NULL for active tasks. Only used for soft delete mechanism.
